summary: Cocrystal Pharma filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 5,474,053 common shares to OPKO Health at $0.9134 per share, raising $5.0 million gross proceeds. The purchase price equaled Nasdaq's consolidated bid price on closing day. No premium, board recommendation, or advisors were mentioned. The sale was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b) to an accredited investor. Philip Frost, OPKO's chairman and CEO, is also a Cocrystal co-founder and director, making this a related-party transaction. Proceeds will fund preclinical and clinical programs. Watch for related-party approval scrutiny and potential future dilution.
